feature.title: From reading a profile to sending a message.
feature.intro: Here’s what you’ll see when you open Histae, and what happens when you both want to talk.

profile.title: Something to start a conversation with
profile.text: Read their bio, answers and personality traits. You’ll see their name and age. Their photo stays hidden until you both want to share it.

preferences.title: Your preferences both matter
preferences.text: Being in someone’s preferred age range is a start. They also need to be in yours. Histae checks who you’re looking for and the maximum distance in both directions too.

location.title: Location that is consensual and temporary
location.text: Discovery requires a recent position and dedicated consent. The position becomes stale after one hour and is deleted after 24 hours without an update.

discovery.title: What’s in your feed?
discovery.text: A bio, answers, a few traits and a rounded distance. People you’ve blocked, already made a choice about or already matched with won’t be suggested again.

stableDecisions.title: Seen that profile before?
stableDecisions.text: Your decision to pass or show interest is saved. You don’t need to make the same choice every time you visit.

reciprocity.title: Your interest stays private
reciprocity.text: A single like doesn’t send a notification. You only match when the other person has chosen you too.

conversationWindow.title: A match, then a first hello
conversationWindow.text: You’ve each shown interest in the other’s profile. Messaging opens for 24 hours, with photos still hidden. Where you start is up to you.

continuationWindow.title: Another 24 hours to choose what comes next
continuationWindow.text: Sending is paused and history stays readable during the 24-hour decision window. Choices remain private until both agree. A decline ends the match immediately; without both agreements by the deadline, it expires.

photoReveal.title: Decide about photos together
photoReveal.text: You can keep talking with your photos hidden. They appear only when each of you agrees, separately from your choice to continue the conversation.

messaging.title: Writing back
messaging.text: Messages can be up to 2,000 characters long. You can see when they’ve been marked as read. Once a match ends, you can’t send it more messages.

continuationCredits.title: A clear choice and credit cost
continuationCredits.text: Each Free participant receives {freeCredits} credits each week. A credit is reserved when they choose to continue a match after the first 24 hours, then spent only after both people agree. A refusal or expiry releases it. An optional video earns 1 credit, with up to {advertisingStock} advertising credits carried over between weeks. Each Free participant can extend up to {weeklyMaximum} conversations per week. A Premium participant uses no credits; the other person keeps their own plan’s limits.

safety.title: Your boundaries belong here.
safety.intro: You choose what to share. If something goes wrong, the tools to act are in the app.

passwordless.title: Passwordless access
passwordless.text: You receive a text-message code to sign in. There’s no password to remember. Attempts are limited to help reduce abuse.

consents.title: A separate choice for each use
consents.text: Accepting the terms, reading the privacy notice, allowing sensitive data and sharing your location are separate steps. Advertising preferences are managed separately too: continuing a match does not agree to ad tracking.

consentWithdrawal.title: You can withdraw permission
consentWithdrawal.text: Withdrawing location permission deletes the stored position. Withdrawing sensitive-data consent removes the relevant gender and preferences. Some features, including profile suggestions, can no longer work afterwards.

rights.title: Get a copy or delete your data
rights.text: Your account has options to request an export, corrections or deletion, as well as other data requests. You can follow their progress in the app.

about.title: Why the words come first.
about.intro: Sometimes the way someone describes their day is enough to make you want to meet them. Histae is built around that possibility.

promise.title: Give the conversation a chance
promise.text: A photo doesn’t tell you what makes someone laugh, what fascinates them or how they listen. A bio and a few messages can tell you a little more.

product.title: Choices you can see in the app
product.text: A bio can be long. Photos wait for two agreements. After the first exchange, each person chooses whether to continue. Those rules are part of Histae from the start.

privacy.title: Permission you can take back
privacy.text: Location and sensitive-data consent can be withdrawn from your account. Showing photos takes agreement from both people, even with Premium.

community.title: There’s more to build
community.text: The app is still in preparation. This site’s screenshots show its current interface with fictional profiles. Download links will be published here once it’s available.

download.title: Not in the stores just yet.
download.intro: Histae is in preparation for iOS and Android, without a confirmed launch date yet. The App Store and Google Play links will be added here when they’re available.

availability.title: On iOS and Android
availability.text: App Store and Google Play links will appear on this page once the app is published.

finalization.title: Start for free
finalization.text: You’ll be able to create a profile and start chatting for free. Premium will be optional, for continuing conversations without spending credits.

officialLinks.title: Your official links
officialLinks.text: Find links to the official stores here. The launch date will be announced once it is confirmed.
